rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this ruleis to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Establishment and Operation of National Cemeteries and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act , as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Request for Designation of State-Managed Cemetery Area) Any person who intends to have a joint burial area (hereinafter referred to as the “joint burial area”)pursuant to Article 3-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of National Cemeteries (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) designated as a state-managed burial area pursuant to Article 2-2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of National Cemeteries (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) shall submit a request for designation of a state-managed burial area in the form of Annex No. 1, attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs, to the Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairsthrough the head of the regional office or branch office having jurisdiction over the location of the joint burial area (in the case where the location of the joint burial area is Jeju Special Self-Governing Province, this refers to the Director of the National Jeju Patriotic Cemetery; hereinafter the same applies in Article 2-3 ). <Amended June 5, 2023; July 23, 2024>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Request for Designation of State-Managed Cemetery Area) Any person who intends to have a joint burial area (hereinafter referred to as the “joint burial area”) designated as a state-managed burial area pursuant to Article 3-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of National Cemeteries (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) and Article 2-2 of the Enforcement Decree of the same Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall submit a request for designation of a state-managed burial area in the form of Annex No. 1, attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs, to the Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs through the head of the regional office or branch office having jurisdiction over the location of the joint burial area (in the case where the location of the joint burial area is Jeju Special Self-Governing Province, this refers to the Director of the National Jeju Patriotic Cemetery; hereinafter the same applies in Article 2-3). <Amended June 5, 2023; July 23, 2024>

rows.text_en: 3. Consent form from all owners and managers of the joint burial site ( applicable only if there are two or more owners or managers of the joint burial site pursuant to the latter part of Article 2-2 of the Enforcement Decree )

rows.source_ko: Article 2-3 (Management of State-Managed Cemeteries) The head of the regional office of veterans affairs orthe head of the branch office of veterans affairs having jurisdiction over the location of a joint cemetery shall record the fact in the State-Managed Cemetery Management Register in the form of Annex 1-3 when a joint cemetery is designated or de-designated as a state-managed cemetery pursuant to Article 2-4 Paragraph 1 or Article 2-5 Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree .

rows.text_en: B. In the case of relocating remains: One copy of the Certificate of Reporting Exhumation, Certificate of Cremation of Exhumed Remains, or Certificate of Return of Remains

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 국립묘지에 안장된 사람의 유족이 국립묘지에서 국립묘지 외의 장소로 시신이나 유골을 이장하는 경우 국립묘지관리소장은 그 이장을 신청한 유족에게 별지 제3호서식의 유골(시신) 인도 확인서를 발급하여야 한다. <개정 2014. 1. 17., 2019. 7. 16.>
rows.text_en: ⑧ In cases where the bereaved family of a person interred in a national cemetery relocates a body or remains from the national cemetery to a place outside the national cemetery, the Director of the National Cemetery Management Office shall issue a Confirmation of Delivery of Remains (Body) in the form of Annex 3 to the bereaved family who applied for the relocation. <Amended Jan. 17, 2014; Jul. 16, 2019>
[Wholly Amended Sep. 9, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제3조의2(국립묘지시설의 설치기준 등) 법 제11조의2제9항에 따른 국립묘지시설의 결정ㆍ구조 및 설치기준은 별표 1과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 3-2 (Standards for Installation of National Cemetery Facilities, etc.) The standards for determination, structure, and installation of national cemetery facilities pursuant to Article 11-2, Paragraph 9 of the Act are as set forth in Table 1.
[This Article Newly Inserted Nov. 28, 2013]

rows.source_ko: 제3조의3(국립묘지시설사업의 대행) ① 법 제11조의10제2항에서 “국가보훈부령으로 정하는 사항”이란 다음 각 호의 사항을 말한다. <개정 2023. 6. 5.>
rows.text_en: Article 3-3 (Agency for National Cemetery Facility Projects) ① The term “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs” in Article 11-10, Paragraph 2 of the Act refers to the matters in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended June 5, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 1. 국립묘지시설사업 시행지의 위치
rows.text_en: 1. Location of the National Cemetery Facility Project Implementation Site

rows.source_ko: 2. 국립묘지시설사업의 종류 및 명칭
rows.text_en: 2. Types and Names of National Cemetery Facility Projects

rows.source_ko: 3. 국립묘지시설사업의 면적 또는 규모
rows.text_en: 3. Area or scale of the national cemetery facility project

rows.source_ko: 4. 국립묘지시설사업대행자의 성명(법인인 경우에는 법인의 명칭을 말한다) 및 주소
rows.text_en: 4. Name (or the name of the corporation in the case of a corporation) and address of the National Cemetery Facility Project Agent

rows.source_ko: 5. 국립묘지시설사업의 대행 범위
rows.text_en: 5. Scope of Agency for National Cemetery Facility Projects

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제11조의10제2항에 따라 국립묘지시설사업을 대행하는 자(이하 “대행자”라 한다)는 국립묘지시설사업의 진행경과, 실적 등을 국가보훈부장관에게 분기별로 보고하여야 한다. <개정 2023. 6. 5.>
rows.text_en: ② A person acting on behalf of the National Cemetery Facility Project pursuant to Article 11-10, Paragraph 2 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Agent”) shall report the progress, performance results, etc., of the National Cemetery Facility Project to the Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs on a quarterly basis. <Amended June 5, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ 국가보훈부장관은 필요하다고 인정하면 해당 대행자에게 제2항에 따른 보고 외에도 국립묘지시설사업에 대한 추가적인 보고를 요청할 수 있다. 이 경우 해당 대행자는 그 요청에 성실히 응하여야 한다. <개정 2023. 6. 5.>
rows.text_en: ③ If the Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs deems it necessary, he or she may request the relevant agent to provide additional reports regarding national cemetery facility projects, in addition to the reports under Paragraph 2. In such case, the relevant agent shall faithfully comply with the request. <Amended June 5, 2023>
[This Article Newly Inserted Nov. 28, 2013]

rows.source_ko: 제3조의4(국립묘지시설사업의 공사완료보고) 대행자가 해당 국립묘지시설사업의 공사를 완료했을 때에는 별지 제8호서식의 국립묘지시설사업 공사완료보고서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 국가보훈부장관에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2020. 9. 25., 2023. 6. 5.>
rows.text_en: Article 3-4 (Report on Completion of Construction for National Cemetery Facility Projects) When an agent has completed the construction of the relevant national cemetery facility project, they shall submit a Report on Completion of Construction for National Cemetery Facility Projects in the form of Annex 8 to the Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs, attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Sep. 25, 2020; Jun. 5, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 1. 준공조서
rows.text_en: 1. Completion Report

rows.source_ko: 2. 설계도서
rows.text_en: 2. Design documents

rows.source_ko: 3. 법 제11조의7제1항에 따른 관계기관의 장과의 협의에 필요한 서류
rows.text_en: 3. Documents required for consultation with the heads of relevant agencies pursuant to Article 11-7 , Paragraph 1 of the Act
[This Article Newly Inserted Nov. 28, 2013]

rows.source_ko: 제4조(관의 규격 등) 영 제14조제3항에 따른 관의 규격 및 재질은 별표 2와 같다. <개정 2013. 11. 28.>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Specifications, etc. of Pipes) The specifications and materials of pipes pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree are as set forth in Attached Table 2. <Amended Nov. 28, 2013>
[Wholly Amended Sep. 9, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제5조(묘 및 부속구조물의 규격) 법 제12조제1항에 따른 묘와 영 제14조제5항에 따른 묘비 등 묘의 부속구조물의 배치ㆍ종류 및 규격은 별표 3과 같다. <개정 2013. 11. 28.>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Specifications of Graves and Ancillary Structures) The arrangement, types, and specifications of graves pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 1 of the Act and ancillary structures of graves, such as gravestones pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 5 of the Enforcement Decree , are as set forth in Attached Table 3. <Amended Nov. 28, 2013>
[Wholly Amended Sep. 9, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제6조(봉안시설의 기준) 영 제16조제4항에 따른 봉안함에는 봉안함별로 고유번호를 부여하고, 봉안명패(奉安名牌)를 설치하되, 봉안명패의 규격 및 재질 등은 별표 4와 같다. <개정 2013. 11. 28.>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Standards for Burial Facilities) A unique number shall be assigned to each burial urn pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree, and a nameplate for burial shall be installed; provided that the specifications and materials, etc., of the nameplate for burial shallbe as set forth in Attached Table 4. <Amended Nov. 28, 2013>
[Wholly Amended Sep. 9, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제7조(유골함의 제작 등) 영 제17조제3항에 따른 유골함의 규격 및 제작 방법은 별표 5와 같다. 다만, 안치용 유골함은 그 규격의 범위에서 각진 모양ㆍ항아리 모양 등으로 그 모양을 변경할 수 있다. <개정 2013. 11. 28.>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Manufacture, etc. of Urns) The specifications and methods of manufacturing urns pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be as set forth in Attached Table 5. However, the shape of urns intended for interment may be changed to an angular shape, a jar shape, etc., within the scope of such specifications. <Amended Nov. 28, 2013>
[Wholly Amended Sep. 9, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제7조의2(자연장지의 개인식별표의 규격 등) 영 제17조의3제3항에 따라 자연장지에 설치되는 개인식별표의 규격 및 재질은 별표 6과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 7-2 (Specifications, etc. of Individual Identification Marks for Natural Burial Grounds) Pursuant to Article 17-3, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree , the specifications and materials of the individual identification markers installed in natural burial grounds are as set forth in Table 6 .
[This Article Newly Inserted Nov. 28, 2013]

rows.source_ko: 제8조(시신 또는 유골의 인수) 국립묘지관리소장은 국립묘지 안장대상자의 시신이나 유골을 인수한 경우에는 별지 제4호서식의 유골(시신)인수대장에 기록하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Acceptance of Body or Remains) When the Director of the National Cemetery Management Office accepts the body or remains of a person eligible for burial in the National Cemetery, he/she shall record it in the Register of Acceptance of Remains (Body) in the form of Annex 4 .
[Wholly Amended Sep. 9, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제9조(임시 안치 등) ① 국립묘지관리소장이 영 제18조제1항에 따라 국립묘지 내 임시 봉안시설에 유골을 임시 안치하는 경우에는 유골함을 흰색 면직으로 싸고 위패지(位牌紙)로 표시하되, 위패지의 규격 및 재질은 별표 7과 같다. <개정 2013. 11. 28.>
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Temporary Interment, etc.) ① Where the Director of the National Cemetery Management Office temporarily intersects cremated remains in a temporary burial facility within a national cemetery pursuant to Article 18, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, the urn shall be wrapped in white cotton cloth and marked with a memorial tablet paper; the specifications and materials of the memorial tablet papershall be as set forth in Attached Table 7. <Amended Nov. 28, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ② 국립묘지관리소장은 제1항에 따라 국립묘지에 임시 안치된 유골이 국립묘지의 안장ㆍ안치 대상이 아닌 것으로 확정된 경우 그 사실을 국립묘지에의 안장을 신청한 유족에게 통보하고 유골을 유족에게 인도하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② If it is determined that remains temporarily interred in a national cemetery pursuant to Paragraph 1 are not eligible for interment or burial in the national cemetery, the Director of the National Cemetery Management Office shall notify the bereaved family who applied for interment in the national cemetery of this fact and hand over the remains to the bereaved family.

rows.source_ko: ③ 국립묘지관리소장은 영 제18조에 따른 유골의 임시 안치와 관련하여 유골을 인수하거나 인도하는 경우 유족에게 별지 제5호서식의 유골 인수ㆍ인도증을 발급하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Director of the National Cemetery Management Office shall issue a Certificate of Receipt and Delivery of Remains in the form of Annex No. 5 to the bereaved family in connection with the temporary interment of remains pursuant to Article 18 of the Enforcement Decree .
[Wholly Amended Sep. 9, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제9조의2(임시안치된 유골에 대한 처리 절차) ① 국립묘지관리소장은 영 제18조제4항에 따라 임시안치된 유골을 산골 등의 방법으로 처리하려면 유족 등에게 그 뜻을 미리 문서로 알려야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 9-2 (Procedure for Handling Remains Temporarily Interred) ① If the Director of the National Cemetery Management Office intends to dispose of remains temporarily interred pursuant to Article 18, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree by means such as scattering, he/she must notify the bereaved family, etc. of his/her intention in advance in writing.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 통보는 임시안치된 유골을 산골 등의 방법으로 처리하기 3개월 전까지 2회 이상 하여야 하며, 제1차 통보를 한 후 1개월이 지난 후에 제2차 통보를 하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The notification under Paragraph 1 must be made at least twice, up to three months before the temporarily interred remains are disposed of by means such as scattering, and the second notification must be made one month after the first notification.
[This Article Newly Inserted Nov. 28, 2013]

rows.source_ko: 제9조의3(이장 비용의 지원신청) 영 제19조의2에 따라 국립묘지로 운구할 때까지의 이장 비용을 지원받으려는 자는 별지 제9호서식의 이장 비용 지원신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 국가보훈부장관에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2023. 6. 5.>
rows.text_en: Article 9-3 (Application for Support for Relocation Expenses) Any person who wishes to receive support for relocation expenses until the body is transported to a national cemetery pursuant to Article 19-2 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit an application for support for relocation expenses in the form of Annex No. 9 to the Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs, attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended June 5, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 1. 별지 제7호서식의 안장확인서 1부
rows.text_en: 1. One copy of the Burial Confirmation Form ( Attachment No. 7 )

rows.source_ko: 2. 안장대상자에게 배우자 및 직계존속ㆍ직계비속이 없음을 확인할 수 있는 서류 1부
rows.text_en: 2. One copy of a document confirming that the person to be buried has no spouse, lineal ascendants, or lineal descendants.
[This Article Newly Inserted Sep. 25, 2020]

rows.source_ko: 제10조(묘적부) 영 제24조에 따른 묘적부는 별지 제6호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Grave Register) The grave register pursuant to Article 24 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 6 of the Attached Form .
[Wholly Amended Sep. 9, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제10조의2(국립묘지지의 작성 등) 국립묘지관리소장은 영 제25조에 따른 국립묘지지(國立墓地誌)를 법 제3조제1항에 따른 국립묘지별로 3년마다 작성하되, 매 10년마다 그간 발행된 국립묘지지를 종합하여 발행할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 10-2 (Preparation of National Cemetery Gazette, etc.) The Director of the National Cemetery Management Office shall prepare a National Cemetery Gazette pursuant to Article 25 of the Enforcement Decree every three years for each national cemetery pursuant to Article 3, Paragraph 1 of the Act, but may compile and publish the National Cemetery Gazettes published so far every ten years.
[This Article Newly Inserted Nov. 28, 2013]

rows.source_ko: 제11조(국립묘지 안장 확인서) ① 국립묘지에 안장된 사람의 유족은 국립묘지관리소장에게 그 유족 관계를 증명할 수 있는 서류를 첨부하여 국립묘지 안장 확인서의 발급을 신청할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Certificate of Interment in National Cemetery) ① The bereaved family of a person interred in a national cemetery may apply to the Director of the National Cemetery Management Office for the issuance of a Certificate of Interment in National Cemetery by attaching documents proving their relationship as bereaved family.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 신청을 받은 국립묘지관리소장은 별지 제7호서식의 안장확인서를 발급하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The head of the National Cemetery Management Office who receives an application pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall issue a burial confirmation certificate in the form of Annex 7.
[Wholly Amended Sep. 9, 2009]
ADDENDA <Prime Minister's Decree No. 804, Feb. 20, 2006>

rows.source_ko: 제1조 (시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조 (묘의 부속구조물에 관한 경과조치) 법 부칙 제3조의 규정에 의하여 묘지의 면적에 관하여 종전의 법령을 적용하는 경우 그 묘에 설치하는 부속구조물의 시설기준은 제5조의 규정에 불구하고 종전의 규정에 의한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning Ancillary Structures of Graves)  In cases where the former laws and regulations are applied to the area of ​​a cemetery pursuant to the provisions of Article 3 of the Addenda to the Act, the facility standards for ancillary structures installed in such graves shall be in accordance with the former regulations, notwithstanding the provisions of Article 5.

rows.source_ko: 제3조 (유골함에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행당시 종전의 규정에 의하여 제작된 유골함은 그 남은 유골함이 모두 소진될 때까지 이 규칙에 의한 유골함과 함께 사용할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Transitional Measures Concerning Urns)  Urns produced in accordance with the previous regulations at the time of the enforcement of this Rule may be used together with urns under this Rule until all remaining urns are exhausted.

rows.source_ko: 제4조 (사용 중인 서식에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행당시 「국립묘지령 시행규칙」, 「국립4ㆍ19묘지규정 시행규칙」 및 「국립5ㆍ18묘지규정 시행규칙」의 규정에 의하여 사용 중인 서식은 계속하여 사용하되, 이 규칙의 내용을 반영하여 사용하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Transitional Measures Concerning Forms in Use)  Forms in use at the time of the enforcement of this Rule pursuant to the provisions of the Enforcement Rule of the National Cemetery Act, the Enforcement Rule of the National 4·19 Cemetery Regulations, and the Enforcement Rule of the National 5·18 Cemetery Regulations shall continue to be used, provided that they are used in accordance with the contents of this Rule.

rows.source_ko: 제5조 (다른 법령의 개정) 참전유공자예우에 관한 법률 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Amendment of Other Laws)  The Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Honorable Treatment of War Veterans are partially amended as follows:

rows.source_ko: 제9조의 제목 “(국립묘지등에의 안장 등)”을 “(묘지에의 안장)”으로 하고, 동조제1항중 “국립묘지등에”를 “묘지에”로, “국립묘지등을”을 “묘지를”로 하며, 동조제2항중 “국립묘지등을”을 “묘지를”로 하고, 동조제3항중 “국립묘지”를 “묘지”로 하며, 동조제4항중 “국립묘지등에”를 “묘지에”로, “국립묘지등을”을 “묘지를”로 한다.
rows.text_en: The title of Article 9, “(Burial in National Cemeteries, etc.)”, shall be changed to “(Burial in a Cemetery)”; in Paragraph 1 of the same article, “in National Cemeteries, etc.” shall be changed to “in a cemetery” and “National Cemeteries, etc.” shall be changed to “a cemetery”; in Paragraph 2 of the same article, “National Cemeteries, etc.” shall be changed to “a cemetery”; in Paragraph 3 of the same article, “National Cemetery” shall be changed to “a cemetery”; and in Paragraph 4 of the same article, “in National Cemeteries, etc.” shall be changed to “a cemetery” and “National Cemeteries, etc.” shall be changed to “a cemetery”.

rows.source_ko: 제6조 (다른 법령의 폐지) 국립4ㆍ19묘지규정 시행규칙 및 국립5ㆍ18묘지규정 시행규칙은 이를 각각 폐지한다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Repeal of Other Laws)  The Enforcement Rules of the National 4·19 Cemetery Regulations and the Enforcement Rules of the National 5·18 Cemetery Regulations are hereby repealed.
